items.title: DIVINE PROTECTION
items.quote: Protect me O G-d, for I have taken refuge with You.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you from danger for you are depending on no one but Him.

items.title: MY MASTER
items.quote: [O my soul,] say to Hashem, You are my Master. My good is not on You [to provide].
items.text: Acknowledge Hashem as the Master of your life, for you owe Him your very existence and there is nothing that He owes you.

items.title: THE HOLY ONES
items.quote: [It is] for the sake of the holy ones who are in the earth and [Your] mighty ones [who fear You]. Because of them all my wishes have been granted.
items.text: Acknowledge your personal debt of gratitude to your holy ancestors and to the living tzadikim of your generation. It is because of their merit that Hashem has granted you life.
“Let their sorrows abound, [those] who hurry after other gods. Avoid emulating people who have committed themselves to false ideals and false powers
items.title: BAD INFLUENCES
COMPLETE DEVOTION
items.quote: Hashem, [You are] my allotted portion and my share. You have determined my destiny.
items.text: Declare your devotion to Hashem. He is the Author of your destiny your mission in life.

items.title: THE SWEETEST
items.quote: My inheritance is beautiful to me.
items.text: Thank Hashem and express your appreciation for the circumstances of life that He has granted you. You did nothing to earn your life.

items.title: COUNSEL
items.quote: I bless Hashem for counseling me.
items.text: Thank Hashem for the guidance He is providing to you, transmitted from those around you and from within your own body.

items.title: CONTINUAL PRESENCE
items.quote: I constantly set Hashem before me.
items.text: Acknowledge Hashem’s constant presence throughout your life. He guides you, sustains you, and protects you.

items.title: CONTINUAL JOY
items.quote: Therefore, my heart rejoices and my soul is elated.
items.text: The knowledge of Hashem’s presence and kindness to you should invoke a state of continual gratitude and joy.

items.title: ETERNAL LIFE
items.quote: For You will not leave my soul in the grave.
items.text: Your joy should be enhanced by the expectation of eternal life.

items.title: DIVINE GUIDANCE
items.quote: Teach me the way to true life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to maintain His continual presence with you and to guide you in making the right choices in life so that you will ultimately be deserving of eternal life.
